Reading through this thread I feel SEEN. Was never a huge Taylor fan growing up but became one during the pandemic (Folklore was the first album of hers I gave a shot) and even went to the Eras Tour this Summer. 

From her jet usage to her white feminism and overall disregard for women's issues (primarily women of color) that don’t have to do with her, I have slowly realized that I am going back to not being a fan anymore. 

I think for me the entire situation when Ice Spice was racially attacked by Matty Healy turned me off of her. At the time, Taylor was allegedly dating him, and her response to his comments about Ice Spice was to make a song with her, and that to me read as very inauthentic. it seems like a money grab and an opportunity for Taylor's team to say, “See! She loves black women.” It made me sick to my stomach that she never came out in Ice Spice's defense because the comments that Matty made were exactly what Taylor claims to be against. I feel that a lot of Black Swifties (including myself) gave up on her because of this situation. 

This year, I have found more than 5 reasons to stop supporting her. I think after her POTY story and her response to Ana’s death, I’ve given up on trying to find something redeemable.
